schema.description: the land register, asked about one lot
the channel it goes to a site through (a visit)
whom it tells of what was built or brought down (none: nobody)

takes.title: Enforcement direction to the building inspector

fines.description: Whether a breach the inspector finds is fined and ordered demolished: yes, as the office does of its own accord; no, it is recorded and nothing more.

fine.description: The fine for a breach, where it is to be other than the office's usual one.

takes.follows: While a direction with fines no stands, the inspector still goes to the sites it is told of and still tells the valuer what was built, but lays no fine and makes no demolition order on a breach: it records the breach in its report. With fines yes, it fines and orders as before, at the amount given if one is.
